candidate_estimators.definition: fraction of five stochastic samples equal to the five-sample majority recommendation
separate deterministic self-evaluation of the probability that the already-frozen SC5 majority recommendation is correct

data_usage.eval_usage: untouched final evaluation after method freeze

derived_diagnostics_not_separate_estimat.reason: with two exact labels and n=5, entropy is a monotonic transformation of the same vote count underlying SC5_AGREEMENT

development_evaluation.fold_assignment: must be frozen before correctness-based estimator comparison
development_evaluation.primary_metric: out-of-fold Brier score for prediction correctness
secondary_metrics: AUROC for distinguishing correct vs incorrect recommendations
AUPRC with incorrect recommendation as the positive failure class
selection_rule: if effectively tied, prefer the estimator with better error-discrimination AUROC
if still tied, prefer SC5_AGREEMENT because it requires no additional model call beyond the recommendation-generation samples

excluded_estimators.reason: under the frozen thinking-enabled Nemotron configuration, returned logprob entries were observed to align with reasoning-generation tokens rather than a clean visible final decision-label token stream; the synthetic probe contained reasoning references to candidate labels that could not be treated as probability of the final visible answer

participant_facing_display.note: estimator and probability calibration are separate from the later HCI/display decision

post_selection.calibration_eval: run exactly once after method freeze
post_selection.failure_safeguard: if the selected calibrated confidence does not show useful correctness discrimination or fails to improve on the constant-confidence baseline on untouched Calibration-EVAL, halt before any participant-facing calibrated-confidence use and require explicit protocol review
post_selection.refit: after estimator/calibrator selection, refit the selected calibration mapping on all valid Calibration-DEV observations

recommendation_generation.canonical_recommendation: strict majority among five valid exact-label samples
recommendation_generation.infrastructure_retry_policy: transport, HTTP429, HTTP5xx and equivalent provider failures may be retried without changing the logical sample set
recommendation_generation.name: SC5_MAJORITY
recommendation_generation.seed_policy: deterministic SHA256-derived item-specific seed; exact implementation frozen before collection
recommendation_generation.validity_requirement: all five choices must parse as exact allowed labels; successful HTTP200 malformed outputs are terminal semantic invalids and are not silently regenerated
